description: Use when trip dates may overlap Tet (Lunar New Year) or another Vietnamese public holiday, when closures, price rises and sold-out transport are likely. Returns the officially announced holiday periods that overlap a date range, who they bind (public sector; private employers may differ), the notice number and source. Dates not yet announced are reported as unknown, not as holiday-free.

to.description: YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to one year after from

name: vn_holiday_calendar

error.description: Present only when the input was invalid
